about: One creator studio, three apps. Hazel brings Shortcraft, Sped and the original Hazel together under one name, one home page and one switcher.

features.title: Hazel Shorts
features.body: Faceless 9:16 explainer shorts: scenes, voice, captions, generated music, MP4 export and YouTube upload.

features.title: Hazel Sped
features.body: Sped-up, slowed and mashup edits of your own songs as 9:16 MP4s; works offline.

features.title: Hazel Long
features.body: A long-form studio: create from a prompt, edit, repurpose and publish.

features.title: Cuts the silences for you
features.body: The Windows desktop app auto-cuts silences and filler words.

features.title: Old links keep working
features.body: Shortcraft and Sped links redirect to their new Hazel homes.
